gizmo.title: Fagen yanayi
gizmo.description: Fage ɗaya na yanayi mai rassa. Haɗa kowane zaɓi da wani fage da # sannan id na fagensa.

configure.title: Id na fage
configure.description: Abin da zaɓuɓɓuka ke haɗuwa da shi: mahaɗi zuwa # sannan wannan id yana kai wa wannan fage. Haruffa, lambobi da layuka.

configure.title: Ƙarshe
configure.description: Ko wannan fage yana kawo ƙarshen hanya, da yadda ya ƙare.

configure.title: Maki
configure.description: Maki don kai wa wannan ƙarshe. Mafi girman makin ƙarshe a cikin yanayin shi ne matsakaicin.
